body.statement: For a distribution generated by a causally minimal restricted additive-noise model satisfying the Condition 19 configurations, the generating DAG is identifiable from the observational distribution.

source.locator: Definition 27 and Theorem 28, pages 13--16 of the article PDF
source.verbatim_statement: Definition 27 Consider an additive noise model (6) with p variables. We call this SEM a restricted additive noise model if for all j in V, i in PA_j and all sets S with PA_j without i contained in S contained in ND_j without i,j, there is an x_S with p_S(x_S) > 0, such that (f_j(x_{PA_j without i}, dot), L(X_i | X_S = x_S), L(N_j)) satisfies Condition 19. Theorem 28 Let L(X) be generated by a restricted additive noise model with graph G_0 and let L(X) satisfy causal minimality with respect to G_0, i.e., the functions f_j are not constant (Proposition 17). Then, G_0 is identifiable from the joint distribution.
